advice.aqi.good: Air quality is good — enjoy outdoor activity.
advice.aqi.moderate: Breathing discomfort possible for people with asthma or heart disease.
advice.aqi.poor: Breathing discomfort for most people on prolonged exposure. Limit outdoor exertion.
advice.aqi.satisfactory: Air is satisfactory; sensitive people may feel minor discomfort.
advice.aqi.severe: Serious health effects for everyone. Stay indoors, run an air purifier, avoid all outdoor exercise.
advice.aqi.very_poor: Respiratory illness on prolonged exposure. Avoid outdoor exercise; wear an N95 outdoors.
advice.comfort.comfortable: Pleasant outside; light clothing is enough.
advice.comfort.fair: Bearable but not ideal — pick shaded or breezy spots.
advice.comfort.uncomfortable: Keep outdoor plans short and hydrate often.
advice.commute.high: Leave early; expect slow traffic and standing water.
advice.commute.leave_early: Leave early; expect slow traffic and standing water.
advice.commute.low: Usual travel time — no weather delays expected.
advice.commute.moderate: Add about 10 minutes and carry a raincoat.
advice.commute.severe: Travel only if necessary — severe conditions on the route.
advice.dust.mask: Wear a mask and eye protection outdoors.
advice.dust.windows: Keep windows shut and cover water storage.
advice.fog.lights: Use low beams and fog lamps, not high beams.
advice.fog.slow: Drive slowly and keep a large gap from the vehicle ahead.
advice.frost.cover: Cover nursery beds and vegetable seedlings.
advice.frost.irrigate: Irrigate lightly in the evening — wet soil releases heat overnight.
advice.frost.shelter: Move livestock and potted plants under shelter.
advice.frost.watch: Light frost possible in low-lying fields before dawn.
advice.hail.cover: Move vehicles and standing crops under cover where possible.
advice.heat.cotton: Wear loose cotton and use ORS if you work outdoors.
advice.heat.hydrate: Drink water every 30 minutes, even without thirst.
advice.heat.stop_work: Heat stroke risk — stop outdoor work and stay indoors.
advice.humidity.dry: Dry air — moisturise and drink water; asthma may flare.
advice.humidity.humid: Sticky air — sweat evaporates slowly, pace yourself.
advice.humidity.oppressive: Oppressive humidity — limit exertion, watch for heat cramps.
advice.pollen.extreme: Extreme pollen — avoid outdoor exposure and keep antihistamines handy.
advice.pollen.high: High pollen — keep windows shut in the morning and shower after being out.
advice.pollen.low: Pollen is low — no precautions needed.
advice.pollen.moderate: Moderate pollen — allergy sufferers should carry medication.
advice.pollen.very_high: Very high pollen — stay indoors during the morning peak if you have allergies.
advice.rain_probability.dry: Very likely dry — outdoor plans are safe.
advice.rain_probability.likely: Rain is likely — book a covered venue or a tent.
advice.rain_probability.possible: Rain is possible — keep a backup indoor option.
advice.rain_probability.wet: Expect rain — move the event indoors if you can.
advice.rainfall.hold: About {mm} mm of rain expected in 3 days — hold irrigation.
advice.rainfall.plan: Little rain in the next 3 days — plan irrigation as usual.
advice.school.avoid: Avoid the trip if you can; check for school closure messages.
advice.school.caution: Send a raincoat and water bottle, and leave a few minutes early.
advice.school.good: Normal school run — nothing special needed.
advice.school.normal: Normal school run — nothing special needed.
advice.school.poor: Poor conditions — consider a covered ride and keep a mask handy.
advice.soil.dry: Soil is drying — plan irrigation within a day or two.
advice.soil.saturated: Soil is saturated — check drainage to avoid root rot.
advice.soil.very_dry: Soil is very dry — irrigate now.
advice.storm.avoid_trees: Do not shelter under trees or near metal poles.
advice.storm.shelter: Move indoors before the storm arrives.
advice.storm.unplug: Unplug appliances and avoid using wired phones.
advice.swim.safe: Sea conditions are suitable for a swim near the shore.
advice.uv.extreme: Extreme UV — stay in the shade; unprotected skin burns in minutes.
advice.uv.high: Use SPF 30+, a hat and sunglasses.
advice.uv.low: UV is low — no protection needed.
advice.uv.moderate: Use sunscreen and seek shade around midday.
advice.uv.very_high: Avoid the sun between 11:00 and 16:00; reapply sunscreen every 2 hours.
advice.visibility.dense_fog: Dense fog — travel only if necessary, use hazard lights at a crawl.
advice.visibility.excellent: Clear all round — no visibility concerns.
advice.visibility.moderate: Slight haze — keep headlights on outside town.
advice.visibility.poor: Reduced visibility — slow down and use low beams.
advice.visibility.very_poor: Very poor visibility — avoid overtaking, use fog lamps.
advice.wetsuit.cold: Cold water — a full wetsuit is advisable.
advice.wetsuit.cool: Cool water — a shorty wetsuit helps for long swims.
advice.wetsuit.pleasant: Pleasant water — swim without a wetsuit.
advice.wetsuit.warm: Warm water — stay hydrated and rinse after the swim.
advice.wind.breezy: Breezy — secure light objects on balconies.
advice.wind.calm: Wind is light — no precautions needed.
advice.wind.gale: Gale-force wind — avoid open ground and hoardings.
advice.wind.secure: Secure loose sheets, hoardings and scaffolding.
advice.wind.strong: Strong wind — two-wheelers should ride carefully.
